versions.content: No support of Com Based Transformer for Trigger commu- nication Due to [constr_5262] it is not possible to define a SystemSignal which is representing a Trigger to be part of a SystemSignalGroup , thus it is not pos- sible to define a Trigger to be processed by a Com Based Transformer (as Com Based Transformer is enabled with the ISignalGroup . comBasedSignalGroup- Transformation ).
